description: A React functional component implementing an authentication form supporting login and signup modes with client-side validation using zod, handling API requests for signup and login, and rendering a styled form with input fields, error notices, and notices.

methods.name: AuthForm
methods.description: React component rendering a form for authentication (login/signup), managing form state, validation, and submission.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates form state when input fields change.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form data against the schema (signup or login).

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles form submission, performs validation, makes API calls, and manages loading and notification states.
